payload.summary: Extractor/parser/OCR/table-strategy/chunker version is not persisted per document, so a parser defect cannot be traced to affected documents (audit F04)
payload.detail: Verified offline: only a coarse indexing_version ('rag-deep-memory-v1') is stored; no extractor/OCR/table-strategy/chunker provenance exists in schema or worker. The clozapine interleaving defect (#GJHKYC) had no deterministic way to list affected documents. Next action: persist per-document extraction provenance and support version-based invalidation/re-extraction. Touches text producers (extract_pdf_assets.py, chunking) and likely a migration: RAG-protected and Supabase-deploy rules apply. Not a prerequisite for the #GJHKYC re-index.
